title: Prepare for and complete an external financial audit
summary: When an audit is required by law, a financing agreement or a voluntary stakeholder decision. Approved financial statements and the auditor's issued report, with findings assigned to remediation owners.
outcomes: Approved financial statements and the auditor's issued report, with findings assigned to remediation owners.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When an audit is required by law, a financing agreement or a voluntary stakeholder decision.

parts.title: Agree audit applicability, scope and independence
parts.guidance: Finance leadership and qualified advisers determine the required reporting framework, periods and engagement type. Select an appropriately qualified independent auditor and confirm access, timetable and responsibilities.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Agree audit applicability, scope and independence

parts.title: Prepare reconciled financial statements and schedules
parts.guidance: Close the relevant periods and assemble trial balances, bank reconciliations, revenue, payroll, equity, debt and tax support. Label estimates and reconcile inconsistencies before supplying the controlled audit workspace.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Manage the evidence request register
parts.guidance: Track each auditor request, owner, source version and response date. Share only authorized information and preserve the provenance of evidence instead of altering records to match an expected result.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Resolve findings and approve management representations
parts.guidance: Management and the auditor discuss proposed adjustments, control issues and unresolved evidence. Authorized management approves corrections and representations; an agent does not provide audit assurance or sign on management's behalf.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Resolve findings and approve management representations

parts.title: Finalize the report and remediation plan
parts.guidance: Confirm that the issued statements and report match the approved versions. Distribute them only to authorized recipients and assign findings, filing obligations and the next audit-preparation cycle.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Finalize the report and remediation plan

verify.how: Approved financial statements and the auditor's issued report, with findings assigned to remediation owners.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
